svg.title: Thirty Days to an Auditable Recovery Operation
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-thirty-day-commercial-recovery-launch; chart type: timeline_roadmap; title: Thirty Days to an Auditable Recovery Operation; subtitle: Four weekly milestones establish readiness without assuming first-month collections.; chapter number: 12; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: The sprint establishes operating capability, not a collection deadline. Canonical time to first deal remains 6–24 months. Training files and synthetic payment records stay separate from authorized live matters.; caption: Finish the month with documented scope, a screened file queue, tested controls, and a funded operating plan. Do not book judgment principal, prospective recoveries, or unsigned fees as revenue.; stages: label: Days 1-7; value: Define jurisdiction, commercial scope, representation roles, and operating economics; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Select one initial jurisdiction and commercial file type. Document licensing research, counsel responsibilities, lawful data sources, fee terms, and expense ownership. Load canonical revenue, margin, and staffing scenarios into a spreadsheet without changing their totals.; label: Days 8-14; value: Build the source-linked screening register and test deadline ownership; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Review 25 lawfully accessible judgment records as an internal process sample, not a sales forecast. Capture entry dates, balances, authority evidence, relevant orders, and review decisions. Have counsel verify jurisdiction-specific deadline logic.; label: Days 15-21; value: Exercise bankruptcy checks, priority review, and payment-allocation controls; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Run five training cases through the four pre-flight checks. Test synthetic partial payments, duplicate receipts, reversals, creditor advances, and fee splits. Confirm that deadline alerts reach a named owner and that system failures produce visible exceptions.; label: Days 22-30; value: Launch bounded creditor outreach and review readiness, capacity, and runway; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Contact an initial list of ten prospective commercial creditor organizations using permitted business channels. Accept live work only within established authority and capacity. Review cash runway, contractor commitments, record completeness, and unresolved legal questions before committing matter-specific expenditure.

rect.title: label: Days 1-7; value: Define jurisdiction, commercial scope, representation roles, and operating economics; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Select one initial jurisdiction and commercial file type. Document licensing research, counsel responsibilities, lawful data sources, fee terms, and expense ownership. Load canonical revenue, margin, and staffing scenarios into a spreadsheet without changing their totals.

text.title: Define jurisdiction, commercial scope, representation roles, and operating economics

rect.title: label: Days 8-14; value: Build the source-linked screening register and test deadline ownership; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Review 25 lawfully accessible judgment records as an internal process sample, not a sales forecast. Capture entry dates, balances, authority evidence, relevant orders, and review decisions. Have counsel verify jurisdiction-specific deadline logic.

text.title: Build the source-linked screening register and test deadline ownership

rect.title: label: Days 15-21; value: Exercise bankruptcy checks, priority review, and payment-allocation controls; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Run five training cases through the four pre-flight checks. Test synthetic partial payments, duplicate receipts, reversals, creditor advances, and fee splits. Confirm that deadline alerts reach a named owner and that system failures produce visible exceptions.

text.title: Exercise bankruptcy checks, priority review, and payment-allocation controls

rect.title: label: Days 22-30; value: Launch bounded creditor outreach and review readiness, capacity, and runway; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Contact an initial list of ten prospective commercial creditor organizations using permitted business channels. Accept live work only within established authority and capacity. Review cash runway, contractor commitments, record completeness, and unresolved legal questions before committing matter-specific expenditure.

text.title: Launch bounded creditor outreach and review readiness, capacity, and runway

Assumptions: The sprint establishes operating capability, not a collection deadline. Canonical time to first deal remains 6–24 months. Training files and synthetic payment records stay separate from authorized live matters.
